payload.text: Issue 0038 (vc approved the plan, 23 Oct): the move rewrites every path into ~/.claude that the settings.json it moves names (absolute, ~, $HOME and ${HOME} spellings, each kept), naming each with its key, and doctor's claude check names any left on a sleeve that declares a config dir. liberators/claude.sh and test/liberators/claude.bats only; one commit, hash and CHANGELOG line to vc.
